annotations.title: A club's league position, recent form and next games

description: Form Guide. A club's league position, recent form and next games. For requests like "how are Arsenal doing?", "what's Spurs' form?", "when do Birmingham play next?"

country.description: Two-letter country code for the shirt link (US, GB and IE get local Amazon links). Default from the request. When passed as US or CA, the say line also gives the next kick-off in US Eastern time.

league.description: One of: premier league, championship, la liga, bundesliga, serie a, ligue 1 (common variants like EPL or German Bundesliga work too). Any other league returns 404. Only needed if two clubs share a name.

q.description: Older name for team, kept for existing callers; team is the current name.

team.description: Club name as the user said it, up to 80 characters. Nicknames and small typos are fine.
